title: The Hebrew calendar: twelve months and the feasts
summary: A full Hebrew calendar of the twelve months from Tishri to Elul, marking Sukkot, Chanukkah, Pesach (Passover) and Shavuot.

text.text: 1 Tishri (Sukkot 15–22) · 2 Cheshvan · 3 Kislev (Chanukkah 25–30) · 4 Tevet · 5 Sh'vat · 6 Adar · 7 Nisan (Pesach / Passover 14–22) · 8 Iyar · 9 Sivan (Shavuot 6–7) · 10 Tamuz · 11 Av · 12 Elul
